coverage.main: Read all twenty-six pages of arXiv 2210.05968v1 (12 October 2022; NeurIPS 2022 paper): Sections 1-5, Tables 1-7, Figures 1-5, references and Appendices A-E (implementation details, flatness computation and cost, comparisons with VT/EMI/Ghost Net/EOT in Tables 8-11, stronger defenses, iteration and ensemble results). The NeurIPS proceedings PDF was not retrieved separately.
coverage.supplement: Appendices are embedded in the arXiv PDF and read.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box (surrogate) cells; Figure 3 (loss-flatness visualisation) and Figures 4-5 plotted ablation curves are graphical transfer results included in the main group but not tabulated; computational-cost figures.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.1-4.5; Tables 1-7 (cols 2-7); Figures 2, 4-5; Appendix Tables 8-11 and iteration/ensemble results
result_groups.population: ImageNet-compatible dataset of 1,000 images; Inc-v3, Res-50, Dense-121, VGG-16 surrogates; normally trained CNN and ViT victims
result_groups.outcome: untargeted or targeted attack success rate
result_groups.evidence: No clean-correct or surrogate-success rule is stated.

result_groups.population: Same images; four-model ensemble source; adv-Inc-v3, ens-adv-IncRes-v2, multi-step AT, input-transformation, feature-denoising and NRP defenses
500 randomly selected images; ResNet-50 surrogate; target class counted if among the 10 returned labels (semantically similar labels merged)
result_groups.outcome: number of images successfully attacked (232 baseline, 342 RAP-LS)
result_groups.evidence: Counts over 500 random images; no API-clean-correct or surrogate-success rule stated.

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy is reported for surrogates, victims, defenses or the API.

f2.evidence: No clean-correct restriction or explicit inclusion statement in any scope.

f3.evidence: No surrogate-success restriction or explicit inclusion statement.

f4.evidence: The Google API scope reports explicit counts (232 and 342 of 500). Table cells are one-decimal rates without a stated denominator.

f5.evidence: Perturbations restricted to L-infinity 16/255 for all attacks.

f6.evidence: The official repository contains a single rap_attack.py and README; models are public (timm/torchvision), but evaluation scripts and defended models are not included. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Linked in the paper. Listed via the GitHub API (head 16 December 2022): README.md and rap_attack.py only. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: No clean baselines; targeted scopes are not misclassification probabilities.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. Plotted ablation values were not digitised.
